title: 第27章 宗师榜龙虎榜精英榜第28章 二爷的仁义靠的是拳头
slug: 骂我朝廷鹰犬我乃大秦武圣
content_zh:
天下宗师不过百，分散在五国三域，就算大秦实力最强，一国宗师境也顶多二十出头。
宗师之下，就是先天境后期。
张远此时修为战力，已经能排到大秦前五十。
因为混沌的存在，外人无法感知他的修为实力，所有见过他真正修为的人，都已经死了。
至于他的武道功法，早在三年前就突破大圆满层次，达到融会贯通。
他将山岳刀法和拳法，以及披风刀法，铁甲拳，还有之后得到的一些功法合一，化为属于自己的功法。
他为这功法起了个名字。
“山河动”。
余林的山岳功法为基础，自身感悟刀法拳法化为大河之劲，绵延不休。
凭借此功法，张远的战力能翻倍。
五年来，为了磨砺战技，为了积攒修行资粮，张远悄然变幻了许多身份。
在庐阳府，他是大秦庐阳府八品皂衣卫张远，作为衙门之中老卒，又是从丰田县城血战归来的唯一人，一众袍泽都敬重他。
就连衙门中的上官，对张远都极为客气。
平常时候，张远在衙门一年当值不到半年，也无人管他。
黑冰台从六品黑甲校尉，代号黑虎，这个身份是三年前燕军退出丰田县，张远和陶公子他们前往祭拜余林等袍泽时候，遇到黑冰台暗探，交流之下，被招入黑冰台。
其实张远本就是皂衣卫，只不过跟真正的黑冰台已经不属于一个序列。
招张远他们入黑冰台的暗探开始时候只是看重他们在丰田县城血战存活，对燕军战法熟悉。
没想到的是，几次任务，张远他们都出色完成，连带着这位暗探步步高升，如今已经是庐阳府黑冰台正六品主官。
赏金猎人黑虎的身份，是陶公子为张远谋划，在江湖上掩人耳目的。
刚好接些暗杀任务，磨砺自身，赚了银钱不说，有时候还能与黑冰台的任务重合，一举数得。

赤狐商队是以当初赵长明带出去的四百残军为根基组建。
丰田县城一战之后，因为违令死守，他们被剥夺军籍，不再有赤鳞军身份。
这四百残军差点落草为寇。
陶公子让张远将手上那些见不得光的银钱拿出来，组建了赤狐商队，赵长明他们常年就在边境往来贸易，商队统领赤狐是谁，只有少数人知道。
青山十八寨共主的身份张远是最不在意的，十八寨需要有人罩着，张二河实力怎么样江湖上没多少清楚，可张二河义薄云天，谁动青山寨，先要想想会不会犯众怒。
五年来，张远做的事情就是磨砺武道，探望袍泽家眷。
真正在他背后谋划的，是陶公子和胡春牛。
陶公子武道断绝，心肺之伤难愈，就将对武道的执念都放在张远身上。
张远凭黑虎之名，登上精英榜时候，陶公子大醉了一场。
按照他所说，要是张远能登上龙虎榜，那他死也瞑目了。
雍天洲一共三榜，宗师榜，龙虎榜，精英榜。
宗师榜共百人，排名是宗师和半步宗师，需要有宗师境战力才可上榜。
宗师境乃是一国核心战力，属于战略威慑，宗师境战力多少，就代表国力多强。
大秦能以一敌数国，就是对单独任何一个国家，宗师境都能碾压。
龙虎榜上，都是成名的先天境，最低也是先天境中期。
雍天洲总共三百位龙虎强者，排名前五十的有一大半都在秦国。
至于精英榜，需要五十岁以下，先天境修为，总五百名，想入榜单，需要击败榜上人物。
陶公子担心张远黑虎身份暴露，就是因为他排名到前百之后，会有许多人为扬名而挑战，寻找黑虎的讯息。
“宗师劫，天道契机，到底如何去寻……”脑海之中光幕消散，盘坐在木榻上的张远口中低低轻语。
踏入宗师境的气血真元他都已经准备充足，可宗师劫是什么，天道契机是什么，他不知道。
content_en:
There are only a hundred grandmasters in the world, scattered among the five kingdoms and three regions. Even if Great Qin is the strongest, the grandmaster level of a country can only be in his early twenties at most.
Below the Grandmaster is the late stage of the Xiantian realm.
At this time, Zhang Yuan's cultivation level and combat strength were already ranked among the top fifty in the Qin Dynasty.
Because of the existence of Chaos, outsiders cannot perceive his cultivation strength, and all those who have seen his true cultivation are dead.
As for his martial arts skills, he broke through the Dzogchen level three years ago and achieved mastery.
He combined the mountain sword technique and boxing technique, as well as the cloak sword technique, armored fist, and some techniques he acquired later, into his own technique.
He gave the technique a name.
"Mountains and rivers are moving".
Based on Yu Lin's mountain skills, his own understanding of sword and boxing skills turned into the power of the river, stretching endlessly.
With this technique, Zhang Yuan's combat power can be doubled.
In the past five years, Zhang Yuan has quietly changed many identities in order to hone his combat skills and accumulate spiritual qualifications.
In Luyang Mansion, he was Zhang Yuan, the eighth-grade Zaoyi Guard of Luyang Mansion in the Great Qin Dynasty. As a senior soldier in the Yamen and the only one who had returned from the bloody battle in Toyota County, everyone respected him.
Even the superior officials in the yamen were extremely polite to Zhang Yuan.
Normally, Zhang Yuan works at the Yamen for less than half a year, and no one cares about him.
Heibingtai was a sixth-grade black-armored captain, codenamed Black Tiger. This identity came from the Yan army's withdrawal from Toyota County three years ago. When Zhang Yuan and Tao Gongzi went to pay homage to Yu Lin and other robes, they met Heibingtai spies. After communicating with him, they were recruited into Heibingtai.
In fact, Zhang Yuan was originally a Zaoyiwei, but he was no longer in the same order as the real Heibingtai.
The spy who recruited Zhang Yuan and others into Black Ice Terrace initially only valued their survival in the bloody battle in Toyota County and their familiarity with the Yan army's tactics.
Unexpectedly, Zhang Yuan and the others completed several missions with flying colours, and the secret agent was promoted step by step, and is now the sixth-rank chief officer of the Luyang Mansion's Black Ice Platform.
The identity of the bounty hunter Black Tiger was plotted by Mr. Tao for Zhang Yuan to hide his identity from others in the world.
I happened to take on some assassination missions to hone myself, and not only made money, but sometimes they overlapped with the missions of Heibingtai, so I could accomplish many things with one fell swoop.
The Red Fox Caravan was formed based on the 400 remnant troops that Zhao Changming brought out.
After the First World War in Toyota County, they were deprived of their military status and no longer had the status of the Red Scale Army because they defied orders and persisted.
These four hundred remnant troops almost fell into the trap of bandits.
Mr. Tao asked Zhang Yuan to take out the shady money in his hands and form a red fox caravan. Zhao Changming and the others had been trading at the border all year round. Only a few people knew who the leader of the caravan, Red Fox, was.
Zhang Yuan is the least concerned about the identity of the co-leader of the Qingshan Eighteen Villages. The Eighteen Villages need someone to protect them. Not much is known about Zhang Erhe's strength, but Zhang Erhe's righteousness means that anyone who touches the Qingshan Village must first think about whether it will offend the public.
In the past five years, Zhang Yuan has been honing his martial arts skills and visiting Paoze's family.
The real masterminds behind him were Mr. Tao and Hu Chunniu.
Mr. Tao's martial arts was cut off and his heart and lung injuries were difficult to heal, so he put his obsession with martial arts on Zhang Yuan.
When Zhang Yuan was on the elite list with the name of Black Tiger, Mr. Tao got drunk.
According to what he said, if Zhang Yuan can be on the Dragon and Tiger List, then he will die in peace.
There are three rankings in Yongtianzhou, the Grandmaster Ranking, the Dragon and Tiger Ranking, and the Elite Ranking.
There are a hundred people on the Grandmaster list, ranked between Grandmaster and Half-Step Grandmaster. You need to have Grandmaster level combat power to be on the list.
The Grandmaster Realm is the core combat power of a country and is a strategic deterrent. The Grandmaster Realm combat power represents how strong the country is.
Da Qin can defeat several countries with one, even if it is a single country, it can crush it at the Grandmaster level.
Those on the Dragon and Tiger list are all in the Xiantian realm who have become famous, and the lowest is in the middle stage of the Xiantian realm.
There are a total of 300 dragon and tiger experts in Yongtian Continent, and more than half of the top 50 are in Qin.
As for the elite list, you need to be under fifty years old and have Xiantian realm cultivation. There are five hundred people in total. If you want to joinThe list requires defeating the characters on the list.
Mr. Tao is worried that Zhang Yuan's identity as Black Tiger will be exposed because after he reaches the top 100, many people will challenge him to become famous and look for information about Black Tiger.
"Grandmaster's Tribulation, how to find the opportunity of heaven..." The light curtain in his mind dissipated, and Zhang Yuan, who was sitting cross-legged on the wooden couch, whispered in a low voice.
He has prepared enough energy, blood and true energy to enter the Grandmaster realm, but he doesn't know what the Grandmaster Tribulation is and what the opportunity of heaven is.
